name: fastify-micro
title: Fastify microservice (TypeScript-only)
description: A Fastify 5 + TypeScript microservice. Ships Redis (ioredis + BullMQ) built-in, built-in pino logger, zod env, /livez + /readyz health endpoints, multistage Dockerfile, and k8s manifests. Database (pg | mysql | none) is a scaffold-time feature axis.
